title: Run ztest rpl_routing DAO-auth matrix on native_sim (AWS builder)
description: Local Mac cannot run native_sim (POSIX arch Linux-only) and local QEMU (qemu_x86_64) hang/blank attempts x3. Commit 65ca175106 rewired lichen/tests/rpl_routing ztest fixtures for the new process_dao/_ex(origin, origin_authenticated) contract and compiles clean under west build -b qemu_x86_64 (Zephyr 4.1.0 workspace, ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=lichen). Runtime validation still needed: from /Volumes/Attic/Developer/zephyr-workspace (or the AWS Zephyr builder vol-0a95eee8d1d8461eb for the pinned v3.7.0), run: west twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T lichen/tests/rpl_routing --outdir /Volumes/Attic/tmp/twister-daoauth-run and confirm all ZTEST cases pass (note twister platform_allow=native_sim only). ZTEST cases affected: test_group_cartesian_and_path_control, test_malformed_group_and_cycle_are_atomic, test_candidate_conflict_and_capacity_are_atomic, test_dao_origin_authorization_matrix, test_canonical_route_state_vectors.
